verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an access-review workflow ('Perform Access Review for a Critical System') and access checks under its Access data library. Its integrations map users with access to connected apps, and the platform claims continuous evidence collection and in-platform task assignment. The evidence is mostly page titles and general claims, so the specific workflow in the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented periodic/recurring review scheduling, an explicit reviewer sign-off step in-app, confirmation that completed review artifacts land in the evidence library, coverage across all connected apps rather than critical systems only, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
